Name: Coldazrael's HD Portraits
Author: coldazrael
Description:
[b]About the Mod[/b]
After long time of planning, sketching, coloring, and delaying, my 1st portrait mod ever is finally released.
This mod replaces all portraits of 46 NPCs in Stardew Valley, Calico Desert and Ginger Island (Including non-humans).
One of the prominent changes from vanilla is the eye color of the NPCs, some will retain their original eye color but some are changed to the previous version of vanilla like :
[list]
[*]Elliott | Changed from Green to the Dark blue
[*]Alex | Changed from Black to Dark Green
[/list]Some NPCs who are blood related will also share their respective eye color to their relatives like :
[list]
[*]Sebastian, Maru and Robin | Dark Gray
[*]Abigail and Caroline | Aquamarine
[*]Penny and Pam | Green
[*]Sam and Jodi | Magenta
[*]Vincent and Kent | Black
[*]Haley and Emily | Blue (which is happened to be earlier version of Emily's eye color)
[*]Shane and Marnie | Dark Brown
[*]George and Alex | Dark Green
[/list]There are also some NPCs' eye color that is changed due to other reasons like :
[list]
[*]Willy | Possibly changed to Desaturated Green because the original is ambiguous
[*]Clint | Changed from Dark Brown to Dark Blue for variety reason
[*]and many others..
[/list]
[b]Installation[/b]
Portraiture :
[list=1]
[*]Download and install Portraiture if you havent installed it yet.
[*]Download the Portrature version of this mod.
[*]Drop the mod folder ( [font=Courier New][Portraiture] Coldazrael's Portraits[/font] ) to [font=Courier New]Mods[/font] folder.
[/list]Note : you can also drop it to [font=Courier New]Mods/Portraiture/Portraits[/font] folder

HD Portraits :
[list=1]
[*]Download and install HD Portraits if you haven't installed it yet.
[*]Download the HD Portraits version of this mod.
[*]Drop the mod folder ( [font=Courier New][HD Portraits] Coldazrael's Portraits[/font] ) to [font=Courier New]Mods[/font] folder.
[/list]
[b]Mods used in the preview :[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1437]Slightly Cuter Character Sprites[/url][b] [/b]by Poltergeister (Highly recommended, I used this mod throughout the development thus it has more closer look than vanilla sprites)
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4697]Vintage Interface v2[/url] by ManaKirel (Fonts disabled in config)
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18678]Transparent Dialogue Interface[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14790]DaisyNiko's Earthy Interiors[/url] by DaisyNiko
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4688]Outdoor Terrain Recolour[/url] by DustBeauty (Seems the mod is either currently hidden or removed)

Big thanks to :
Pathoschild, Platonymous and tlitookilakin for their frameworks I'm able to make this mod exist
DCBurger, ohodavi, NongDarn﻿ and Poltergeister for the ideas I'm inspired to
